mapper.select: SELECT total_slots FROM hd_route WHERE route_no = #{routeNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.slot_no, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_shift_slot h WHERE h.route_no = #{routeNo} AND h.slot_no = s.slot_no) AS enabled, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_timetable t WHERE t.route_no = #{routeNo} AND t.day_type = 'WEEKDAY' AND t.slot_no = s.slot_no) AS in_weekday, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_timetable t WHERE t.route_no = #{routeNo} AND t.day_type = 'SATURDAY') THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_timetable t WHERE t.route_no = #{routeNo} AND t.day_type = 'SATURDAY' AND t.slot_no = s.slot_no) ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_timetable t WHERE t.route_no = #{routeNo} AND t.day_type = 'HOLIDAY' AND t.slot_no = s.slot_no) END AS in_saturday, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_timetable t WHERE t.route_no = #{routeNo} AND t.day_type = 'HOLIDAY' AND t.slot_no = s.slot_no) AS in_holiday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hd_timetable t WHERE t.route_no = #{routeNo} AND t.day_type = 'WEEKDAY' AND t.slot_no = s.slot_no AND t.shift = 'MORNING') AS weekday_am_trips FROM generate_series(1, (SELECT total_slots FROM hd_route WHERE route_no = #{routeNo})) AS s (slot_no) ORDER BY s.slot_no
SELECT night_no, depart_min FROM hd_night_trip ORDER BY night_no
mapper.update: UPDATE hd_night_trip SET depart_min = #{departMin}, updated_at = now() WHERE night_no = #{nightNo}
mapper.select: SELECT route_no, min_rest_min FROM hd_night_rule ORDER BY route_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hd_night_rule (route_no, min_rest_min) VALUES (#{routeNo}, #{minRestMin}) ON CONFLICT (route_no) DO UPDATE SET min_rest_min = EXCLUDED.min_rest_min, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT day_type FROM (SELECT DISTINCT day_type FROM hd_timetable WHERE route_no = #{routeNo}) d ORDER BY CASE day_type WHEN 'WEEKDAY' THEN 1 WHEN 'SATURDAY' THEN 2 WHEN 'HOLIDAY' THEN 3 WHEN 'VACATION' THEN 4 END
SELECT slot_no, MAX(arrive_min) AS last_arrive_min FROM hd_timetable WHERE route_no = #{routeNo} AND day_type = #{dayType} GROUP BY slot_no ORDER BY slot_no
SELECT slot_no, night_no FROM hd_night_slot WHERE route_no = #{routeNo} AND day_type = #{dayType} ORDER BY slot_no, night_no
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hd_night_slot WHERE route_no = #{routeNo} AND day_type = #{dayType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hd_night_slot (route_no, day_type, slot_no, night_no) VALUES (#{routeNo}, #{dayType}, #{slotNo}, #{nightNo})
